【New Alert】(Posted: September 4, 2026)

Saitama Prefecture is expected to experience unstable atmospheric conditions due to a front stalled near Honshu and warm, moist air.

Be alert and cautious of flooding in low-lying areas, river overflow, and landslides.

Check the Japan Meteorological Agency website for Kikiruku (hazard map) and time-series forecasts, and stay informed of the latest weather disaster advisories.

Japan Meteorological Agency: Hanno disaster prevention information (external site)

• Time-series information
• Weather disaster prevention and meteorological commentary
• Warnings, advisories, and early warnings
• Kikiruku (real-time hazard map)
• Japan Meteorological Agency homepage
